title: ProtoSchema
description:
Root of the generated JSON Schema: one field per top-level protocol type.

Never sent on the wire; it exists so `cargo xtask schema` can emit a single schema whose
`$defs` contain every protocol type.

function_page.description: A page of function summaries, the canonical [`Page`] instantiation.

untrusted_string.description: An untrusted string, the canonical [`Untrusted`] instantiation.

AddressRange.description: A half-open address range `[start, end)` in one address space.

end.description: One past the last offset, hex-encoded.

start.description: First offset in the range, hex-encoded.

Anchor.description:
A stable reference persisted in the edit log: function entry plus content hash.

Serialized with `"kind"` as the tag and always stored together with the log schema version.
Only `Native` is implemented; the other variants are reserved and rejected by [`Anchor::native`].

oneOf.description: An address plus the entry and content hash of the containing function.

fn_entry.description: Entry offset of the containing function, hex-encoded.

fn_hash.description: Hash of the function's original bytes, as an opaque string.

offset.description: Offset of the anchored item, hex-encoded.

oneOf.description: Reserved: a managed-code member identified by a token.
Reserved: an address within a bank of a banked address space.

Bitfield.description: Position of a bitfield within its storage unit.

bit_offset.description: Bit offset from the least significant bit of the storage unit at the field offset.

BytesRead.description:
Bytes read from program memory. The read may be shorter than requested when it reaches the
end of mapped memory.

bytes.description: The bytes, base64-encoded on the wire (standard alphabet, padded).

uninitialized.description: Sub-ranges of the read that lie in uninitialized memory; their bytes are zero.

Capability.description: One named capability an engine or server offers.

Cfg.description: The control-flow graph of one function.

blocks.description: Blocks ordered by start address; the one at the entry is first by convention only.

edges.description: Edges between blocks of the function; calls and edges leaving the function are omitted.

CfgBlock.description: A basic block of a function.

instructions.description: Number of instructions in the block.

CfgEdge.description: An edge between two blocks, named by their start addresses.

oneOf.description: The next block follows without a branch.
Branch taken when the condition holds.
Branch not taken (the fall-through of a conditional jump).
One case of a computed jump such as a switch table.

CodeData.description:
What an address is defined as.

Serialized with `"kind"` as the tag.

oneOf.description: Comment above a function or label.
Comment on the line before an instruction.
Comment on the line after an instruction.
Repeatable comment shown at every reference.

Completeness.description:
How much analysis backs a result (decision 36).

Serialized with `"kind"` as the tag.

oneOf.description: All analysis relevant to this result has finished.
Analysis is still running or was cut short.
The item has not been analysed at all.

Composite.description: Layout of a struct or union.

text.description: Decompiled source text; binary-derived, so sanitise it at ingestion.

tokens.description: Token spans into `text`, in increasing start order.

bytes.description: Instruction bytes as contiguous lower-case hex.

comment.description: End-of-line or plate comment at the address, if any.

flow.description: Control flow out of the instruction.

operands.description: Operands flattened to tokens, with separators as `other` tokens.

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error code; the snake_case strings never change once released.

oneOf.description: The addressed entity does not exist.
A request argument is malformed or out of range.
A write was based on a read that is no longer current; re-read and retry.
A concurrent human edit won over an agent edit.
The engine refused to apply a change.
The operation or variant is not supported by this engine or version.
The result depends on analysis that has not finished.
The deadline passed before the operation finished.

Field.description: One field of a struct or union.

bitfield.description: Bit position and width when the field is a bitfield.

offset.description: Byte offset from the start of the composite.

FlowKind.description: Control flow out of an instruction.

oneOf.description: Execution continues with the next instruction.
Computed jump or call whose target is not a constant.
Anything else that ends or redirects flow, such as a halt.

calling_convention.description: Calling convention name, such as `"__cdecl"`; empty for the engine default.

name.description: Prototype name; absent for anonymous prototypes.

varargs.description: Whether the function takes variable arguments.

FunctionRef.description: A function named by an address.

FunctionSummary.description: A short description of one function for listings.

fn_hash.description: Content hash of the function's bytes, as used in anchors.

name.description: Current function name; binary-derived, so sanitise it at ingestion.

size.description: Size of the function body in bytes, if known.

Handshake.description: Handshake payload: protocol version, build identity and capability list.

build.description: Free-form build identifier of the sender.

Hex64.description: Unsigned 64-bit integer as a 0x-prefixed hex string.

Locator.description:
Where something lives in a program; protocol-level and extensible with new variants.

Serialized with `"kind"` as the tag. Managed-code member tokens are added when an engine needs them.

oneOf.description: An offset in a named address space.

offset.description: Offset within the space, hex-encoded on the wire.

LogOp.description: One edit-log operation; each carries the anchor it applies to and the old value for undo.

old_name.description: Name before the edit, if any.

oneOf.description: Set the type of an item.

old.description: Type before the edit, if any.

new.description: Text after the edit; absent clears the comment.

old.description: Text before the edit, if any.

body.description: Explicit body, if the engine should not infer it.

name.description: Name to give the function, if any.

old_body.description: Body before the edit, kept for undo.

old.description: Body before the edit, if known.

oneOf.description: Mark an address as code, data or undefined.

length.description: Length in bytes of the affected region, if not implied by the type.

old.description: Definition before the edit, if known.
Convention before the edit, if known.

LogStatus.description:
Outcome of applying a log entry (decision 27).

Serialized with `"kind"` as the tag.

oneOf.description: The anchor could no longer be resolved.

MemoryBlock.description: One block (segment or section) of the program's memory.

end.description: First address after the block (half-open, like [`AddressRange`]).

initialized.description: Whether the block has file or zero contents; uninitialized blocks (like `.bss`) have none.

perms.description: Permissions as three characters, `r`, `w`, `x` or `-` in that order, such as `r-x`.

MemoryKind.description: How a memory block is backed.

oneOf.description: Ordinary block, initialized from the file or zero-filled.
Overlay block in its own address space.
Bytes are mapped from another part of memory.
Bits are mapped from another part of memory.
A numeric constant that is not an address.
An address that has a symbol; `text` is the symbol name and `target` the address.
Punctuation, size keywords and anything else.

OperandToken.description: One piece of an instruction operand.

target.description: The address an address or symbol token refers to.

text.description: Text of the token; for [`OperandKind::Symbol`] the raw symbol name.

Page.description: One page of results with an optional cursor for the next page.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

total.description: Total item count when the engine can cheaply provide it.

PageRequest.description: Cursor and size for one page of a paginated query.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous [`Page::next_cursor`]; absent for the first page.

Param.description: One parameter of a function prototype.

storage.description: Storage description such as `"RDI"` or `"stack+8"`, if known.

Primitive.description: A primitive type with explicit size and signedness.

class.description: What kind of primitive this is.

signed.description: Whether the type is signed (meaningful for `int`, `char` and `float`).

oneOf.description: Opaque bytes of known size and unknown meaning.

ProtoError.description: A protocol error: a stable code, a human-readable message and optional structured details.

message.description: Human-readable description; not for programmatic matching.

ProtocolVersion.description: Protocol version; a different `major` is incompatible.

oneOf.description: Produced by an agent from its own reasoning.
Produced by an agent from text found in the binary; always treated as untrusted.

StringEncoding.description: Character encoding of a string in memory.

length.description: Length in bytes in memory, including the terminator when there is one.

address.description: Address: the definition for an export, the stub or thunk (if any) for an import.

library.description: Library an import comes from, when known (binary-derived).

SyncState.description:
Whether a log entry has reached the engine (decision 57).

Serialized with `"kind"` as the tag.

oneOf.description: Not yet sent to the engine.

Token.description: A span of the decompiled text with optional links to program entities.

end.description: End byte offset into the text (exclusive).

start.description: Start byte offset into the text (inclusive).

symbol.description: Symbol name the token refers to, if any.

target.description: Program location the token refers to, if any.

varnode.description: Engine-neutral varnode description such as `"unique:0x1f80:4"`, if any.

TokenKind.description: Syntactic category of a decompiler token.

TypeDef.description:
A named type definition.

Serialized with `"kind"` as the tag.

TypeRef.description:
A use of a type: either a named definition or an anonymous composition of references.

Serialized with `"kind"` as the tag.

oneOf.description: A reference to a [`TypeDef`] by its name.
A pointer with an explicit size in bytes.
An anonymous function prototype (for function pointers).

VersionedLogOp.description: A [`LogOp`] together with the schema version it was written under.

to_function.description: The function whose entry is `to`, if any.

oneOf.description: Other data reference such as a pointer or an address taken.
